# ERC-4626 (`erc4626`)

Standard interface for tokenized vaults (EIP-4626). Provides deposit, withdraw, mint, redeem and preview functions that any conforming vault implements.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Infrastructure and standards |
| Family | none |
| Namespace | none: import its ABI |
| Chains | none recorded |
| Document | [erc4626.md](../erc4626.md): what it is for, how to choose it, its pitfalls |

## In a program

The registry records no deployment: `VaultABI` is an interface, bound to an address the
program is given.

```sauce chain=ethereum
import VaultABI from "./protocols/erc4626/VaultABI.json";

const TARGET = 0n; // the contract's address, as a define

function main() {
  const target = VaultABI.at(TARGET);
}
```

## ABI

### `VaultABI`

`import VaultABI from "./protocols/erc4626/VaultABI.json";`

- `deposit(uint256 assets, address receiver) returns (uint256 shares)`
- `mint(uint256 shares, address receiver) returns (uint256 assets)`
- `withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner) returns (uint256 shares)`
- `redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner) returns (uint256 assets)`
- `totalAssets() view returns (uint256)`
- `convertToShares(uint256 assets) view returns (uint256)`
- `convertToAssets(uint256 shares) view returns (uint256)`
- `previewDeposit(uint256 assets) view returns (uint256)`
- `previewMint(uint256 shares) view returns (uint256)`
- `previewWithdraw(uint256 assets) view returns (uint256)`
- `previewRedeem(uint256 shares) view returns (uint256)`
- `maxDeposit(address receiver) view returns (uint256)`
- `maxMint(address receiver) view returns (uint256)`
- `maxWithdraw(address owner) view returns (uint256)`
- `maxRedeem(address owner) view returns (uint256)`
- `asset() view returns (address)`
